brief: Inspect Wexford Green 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-341) immediately to bring forward its overdue detailed inspection, as the asset has an unverified cooling system (REG-042). Because the unit has an advanced age of 45 years and cannot be attended for full resolution prior to the heat event, apply the loading restrictions specified in MG-021 in preference to accepting the thermal exposure (MG-023).
